1.ja: קד געלתך אסתאדא פי אמר פרעון
1.en: I have made you a master in the matter of Pharaoh
and Aaron your brother shall be your spokesman

2.ja: אנת תכלם הרון אכ'יך בגמיע מא אמרך בה
2.en: You shall speak to Aaron your brother with all that I command you
and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh
that he may release the sons of Israel from his land

3.en: And I shall harden the heart of Pharaoh
and multiply My signs and My proofs

4.en: And Pharaoh shall not accept from you
until I bring My plagues upon the Egyptians

4.ja: ואכ'רג גיושי. קומי בני אסראיל מן בלד מצר
4.en: and bring forth My hosts — My people, the sons of Israel — from the land of Egypt
4.he: וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶת-צִבְאֹתַי אֶת-עַמִּי בְנֵי-יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם

5.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am God
when I release My plagues upon them
and bring out the sons of Israel from among them

7.en: And Moses was eighty years of age
and Aaron eighty-three years of age
when the two of them spoke to Pharaoh

8.ja: ת'ם קאל אללה. למוסי והרון קאילא
8.en: Then God said to Moses and Aaron, saying

9.ja: כ) אד'א כלמכם פרעון. וקאל אעטוני ברהאנא
9.en: When Pharaoh speaks to you and says: Give me a proof
9.he: כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵכֶם פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם מוֹפֵת

9.en: then say to Aaron: Take your staff
and throw it before him; it shall become a serpent

10.en: And Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh
and did so, as God had said

10.ja: וטרח הרון עצאה. בין ידי פרעון וקואדה
10.en: and Aaron threw his staff before Pharaoh and his officers
10.he: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת-מַטֵּהוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו

11.en: Then Pharaoh called for the sages and the sorcerers
and the learned men of Egypt did the same with their secret arts

12.ja: טרח כל רגל עצאה. פצארת כאלתנאנין
12.en: Each man threw his staff, and they became like serpents
but Aaron's staff swallowed their staves

13.en: and he did not accept from them

14.en: The heart of Pharaoh has grown heavy
and he has refused to release the people

15.en: Go to him in the morning
behold, he is going out to the water
and stand to meet him on the shore of the Nile

15.ja: ואלעצא. אלד'י אנקלבת ת'עבאנא כ'ד'הא בידך
15.en: and the staff which turned into a serpent, take it in your hand

16.en: God, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you
that they may serve me in the open country
and behold, you have not accepted until now

17.ja: בהד'ה אלכ'לה תעלם. אני אללה אלמעאקב
17.en: By this means shall you know that I am God, the One who punishes

17.ja: האנא צ'ארב באלעצא אלתי פי ידי
17.en: behold, I am striking with the staff that is in my hand

17.ja: אלמא אלד'י פי אלניל פינקלב דמא
17.en: the water which is in the Nile, and it shall turn to blood

18.en: And the fish that are in the Nile shall perish

18.ja: ויעגז אלמצריון. אן ישרבון מאא מן אלניל
18.en: and the Egyptians shall be unable to drink water from the Nile

19.en: Say to Aaron: Take your staff

19.ja: ומד ידך עלי' מיאת אלמצריון. ואנהארהם וכ'לגאנהם ואגאמהם
19.en: and stretch out your hand over the waters of the Egyptians — over their rivers and their inlets and their marshes
19.he: וּנְטֵה-יָדְךָ עַל-מֵימֵי מִצְרַיִם עַל-נַהֲרֹתָם עַל-יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְעַל-אַגְמֵיהֶם

19.en: and the rest of the gatherings of their waters — that they may turn to blood

19.ja: ויכון דם פי גמיע בלד מצר. ופי אואני אלכ'שב ואלחגארה
19.en: and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, and in vessels of wood and of stone
19.he: וְהָיָה דָם בְּכָל-אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבָעֵצִים וּבָאֲבָנִים

21.en: And the fish that were in the Nile perished

21.ja: ועגז אלמצריון. אן ישרבו מנה מאא
21.en: and the Egyptians were unable to drink water from it

21.ja: פצאר אלדם פי גמיע בלד מצר
21.en: and blood was throughout all the land of Egypt

22.en: And the learned men of Egypt did the same with their secret arts
and he did not accept from them

23.ja: ת'ם ולא פרעון. ודכ'ל אלי' מנזלה
23.en: Then Pharaoh turned away and entered his house

23.ja: ולם ירד באלה אלי' הד'א איצ'א
23.en: and did not set his mind to this either

24.ja: ואחתפר גמיע אלמצריון. חואלי אלניל אבארא לישרבו מנהא
24.en: And all the Egyptians dug wells around the Nile to drink from them
24.he: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ כָל-מִצְרַיִם סְבִיבֹת הַיְאֹר מַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת

24.ja: אד' לם יטיקו אן ישרבו. מן מא אלניל
24.en: since they could not bear to drink from the water of the Nile
24.he: כִּי לֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר

25.en: And when seven days had been completed

25.ja: בעד מא צ'רב אללה אלניל בד'אלך
25.en: after God had struck the Nile — thereafter

26.en: and say to him: Thus says God
release my people, that they may serve me

27.en: And if you refuse to release them
behold, I am about to strike your territory with frogs

28.en: And the frogs shall move forth from the Nile

28.ja: ותצעד ותדכ'ל פי ביתך. ופי כ'דר מצ'געך ועלי' סרירך
28.en: and shall ascend and enter into your house, and into the inner chamber of your bed and upon your bed
28.he: וְעָלוּ וּבָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבַחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְעַל-מִטָּתֶךָ

29.en: And upon your person and upon the person of your people and your officers
